review: The hymn is the 'just as I am' confession: 1:1–4 is Rev 22:17 with Matt 11:28, 2:1–4 is 1 John 1:7 with Ps 51:4, 3:1–4 is Ps 34:7 with 2 Cor 8:9, and 4:1–4 is Ps 103:3 with John 4:14 and Matt 11:30.

The last line of every stanza is the same address (הוֹי שֵׂה הָאֱלֹהִים הֶעָנָו), as the print closes all four with يَا حَمَلَ اللهِ الْوَدِيع; the payload keeps the glossary's שֵׂה הָאֱלֹהִים unchanged in all four.

3:1–2 keep the print's broken syntax (كَمَا أَنَا، لِأَنَّنِي / ذُو فَاقَةٍ) as a subordinate clause split across the line-break, because the stanza's humility depends on the sentence stumbling over itself.
